understanding the effects of non-circularity in the CMB beam on the power-spectrum estimation.

the non-circular beam correction is a necessary ingredient to extract the maximum amount of information from the current generation of high angular resolution CMB experiments.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have derived an analytic framework to correct for beam non-circular effects in CMB data analysis.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of non-circularity on the power spectrum depends on the mask, and that it is important to correct the power spectrum for this effect when the non-circularity is significant.
the power spectrum of the non-circular beam is a convolution of the circular beam power spectrum and the azimuthal power spectrum of the mask.
the effect of beam ellipticity on the CMB power spectra can be corrected to high precision using the analytic framework presented in this paper.
